source: TSTD, comprehensive mung bean cultivation manual, "សណ្តែកបាយ" [Mung bean], 2013
text: Fertilizer guidance covers a basal (pre-sowing) application and a top-dress application, with rates given by variety group — the manual distinguishes rate recommendations for different named variety types (referred to in the source using local variety-group names including Angkor-type, Chey-type, and a potassium-responsive type), reflecting that different mung bean varieties in Cambodian use have somewhat different nutrient responsiveness and yield potential.
